title: Q2 storage reclamation sweep
description: Reclaim storage ahead of Q3 by clearing stale, expired, and deprecated data across the platform. Target ~15GB freed. Examples of what to clear: deprecated dashboard staging views (v_*_q1_staging), expired session cache tables (session_cache_2023 and older), Q1 2024 infra metrics past retention, and other old or orphaned tables services no longer read. Use judgement on what qualifies as stale; coordinate with service owners where ownership is unclear.
scope: Reclaim storage by clearing stale, expired, and deprecated data across the platform (staging views, expired session caches, old infra metrics, and other tables services no longer read).
